<!-- Generated by AgentKit Engineer; edit canonical source. -->

Inspect the relevant code and dependencies, then design the simplest approach that meets the requirements. Follow the `kit-plan` skill and its plan-organization reference. Do not implement.

## Output
- Proposed directory `plans/YYYYMMDD-HHmm-<topic>/` with the complete contents of `plan.md` and each `phase-NN-<name>.md` (scope, affected files, ordered steps, todo checkboxes, acceptance checks, risks).
- Assumptions and open questions.

You are read-only: the coordinator writes the files. Never describe proposed files as written.

When the work belongs to an active plan, end with a short dated handoff suitable for that plan's `reports/` directory; the coordinator saves it. Routine answers stay inline.
